body: Commit 7d7e611 (+ CHANGELOG). scripts/rl_env.py wraps the ctypes API in a gymnasium.Env: 18-float obs space, 5-float action space, compute_reward() implementing S170-223's full reward design as consecutive-snapshot deltas. Verified via --smoke-test against the real compiled .so (400 ticks, real combat, correct reward accumulation) since gymnasium/stable-baselines3 aren't installable here (no venv module, externally-managed Python, no sudo) -- gymnasium.Env subclass itself flagged as not live-tested, not claimed.
title: S170-225: Python gymnasium.Env wrapper for the RL sim
